# Gaudiya Kirtan Color Scheme

This document defines the unified color scheme for the Gaudiya Kirtan application across all platforms.

> **The Palette table below is authoritative.** The per-platform code blocks further down are
> illustrative — where they differ from the table, follow the table. Recent corrections: Gaura
> `tertiary` → `#5A5A5A` (was a `#1A1A1A` typo); added the `onHighlight` token for on-accent text.

## Color Palette

| Name | Light Mode (Gaur) | Dark Mode (Shyam) | Description |
|------|-------------------|-------------------|-------------|
| `primary` | `#1A1A1A` | `#E0E0E0` | Primary text and important content |
| `secondary` | `#3A3A3A` | `#B8B8B8` | Secondary text and content |
| `tertiary` | `#5A5A5A` | `#9B9B9B` | Tertiary text and content (corrected from `#1A1A1A`, which duplicated `primary` and collapsed the light-mode hierarchy) |
| `accent` | `#B36B00` | `#8CB4FF` | Accent color for interactive elements |
| `highlight` | `#B36B00` | `#8CB4FF` | Highlight color for important elements and links |
| `onHighlight` | `#FFFFFF` | `#1A1A1A` | Text/icon color placed **on** an accent/highlight fill. Shyam's accent is light blue, so on-accent content is near-black there, white in Gaura. |
| `background` | `#FFF4E8` | `#191919` | Main background color |
| `backgroundOffset` | `#F6E5D1` | `#202020` | Secondary background for cards and UI elements |
| `border` | `#E6D7C3` | `#333333` | Border color for UI elements |
| `neutral` | `#6E6E6E` | `#9B9B9B` | Neutral text and less important content |

## Implementation Guide

### iOS (Swift)

Colors are defined in the Assets catalog and accessed using SwiftUI's Color extension:

```swift
// Color extension is automatically generated by asset catalog
Color.primary       // Primary text color
Color.secondary     // Secondary text color
Color.accent        // Accent color for interactive elements
Color.highlight     // Highlight color for important elements
Color.background    // Main background color
Color.backgroundOffset // Secondary background color
Color.neutral       // Neutral text color
```

### Android (Kotlin/Java)

```xml

<color name="secondary_light">#3A3A3A</color>

<color name="background_light">#FFF4E8</color>
<color name="background_offset_light">#F6E5D1</color>
<color name="border_light">#E6D7C3</color>
<color name="neutral_light">#6E6E6E</color>

<!-- Dark theme colors (Shyam) -->
<color name="primary_dark">#E0E0E0</color>
<color name="secondary_dark">#B8B8B8</color>

```

For Jetpack Compose:

```kotlin
val LightColorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    secondary = Color(0xFF3A3A3A),
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    tertiary = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    onTertiary = Color.White,
    background = Color(0xFFFFF4E8),
    onBackground = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    surface = Color(0xFFF6E5D1),
    onSurface = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    outline = Color(0xFFE6D7C3),
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFFB36B00),
    onSurfaceVariant = Color.White
)

val DarkColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    onPrimary = Color.Black,
    secondary = Color(0xFFB8B8B8),
    onSecondary = Color.Black,
    tertiary = Color(0xFF9B9B9B),
    onTertiary = Color.Black,
    background = Color(0xFF191919),
    onBackground = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    surface = Color(0xFF202020),
    onSurface = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    outline = Color(0xFF333333),
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFF8CB4FF),
    onSurfaceVariant = Color.Black
)
```

### Web (CSS/TailwindCSS)

CSS variables defined in `colors.css`:

```css
/* Define color palettes directly */
:root {
  /* Light theme colors (Gaur) */
  --gaur-primary: #1A1A1A;
  --gaur-secondary: #3A3A3A;
  --gaur-tertiary: #1A1A1A;
  --gaur-accent: #B36B00;
  --gaur-highlight: #B36B00;
  --gaur-background: #FFF4E8;
  --gaur-background-offset: #F6E5D1;
  --gaur-border: #E6D7C3;
  --gaur-neutral: #6E6E6E;
  
  /* Dark theme colors (Shyam) */
  --shyam-primary: #E0E0E0;
  --shyam-secondary: #B8B8B8;
  --shyam-tertiary: #9B9B9B;
  --shyam-accent: #8CB4FF;
  --shyam-highlight: #8CB4FF;
  --shyam-background: #191919;
  --shyam-background-offset: #202020;
  --shyam-border: #333333;
  --shyam-neutral: #9B9B9B;
  
  /* Default to light theme */
  --primary: var(--gaur-primary);
  --secondary: var(--gaur-secondary);
  --tertiary: var(--gaur-tertiary);
  --accent: var(--gaur-accent);
  --highlight: var(--gaur-highlight);
  --background: var(--gaur-background);
  --background-offset: var(--gaur-background-offset);
  --border: var(--gaur-border);
  --neutral: var(--gaur-neutral);
}

/* Dark mode overrides */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --primary: var(--shyam-primary);
    --secondary: var(--shyam-secondary);
    --tertiary: var(--shyam-tertiary);
    --accent: var(--shyam-accent);
    --highlight: var(--shyam-highlight);
    --background: var(--shyam-background);
    --background-offset: var(--shyam-background-offset);
    --border: var(--shyam-border);
    --neutral: var(--shyam-neutral);
  }
}
```

For TailwindCSS configuration:

```js

module.exports = {

          tertiary: '#9B9B9B',
          accent: '#8CB4FF',
          highlight: '#8CB4FF',

}
```

## Cross-Platform Color Usage

When implementing components across platforms, use these color mappings:

| Element | iOS/Swift | Android/Kotlin | Web/React |
|---------|-----------|----------------|-----------|
| Text (primary) | `Color.primary` | `R.color.primary_light/dark` | `text-primary` |
| Text (secondary) | `Color.secondary` | `R.color.secondary_light/dark` | `text-secondary` |
| Backgrounds | `Color.background` | `R.color.background_light/dark` | `bg-background` |
| Card backgrounds | `Color.backgroundOffset` | `R.color.background_offset_light/dark` | `bg-offset` |
| Accents/Highlights | `Color.highlight` | `R.color.highlight_light/dark` | `text-highlight` |
| Borders | `Color.border` | `R.color.border_light/dark` | `border-border` |
| Neutral elements | `Color.neutral` | `R.color.neutral_light/dark` | `text-neutral` |
